dict.string: Neura uses this permission to measure campaign performance and improve the app. Your medical data is never used for tracking.
Neura reads your health data (height, weight, date of birth, and biological sex) to pre-fill your health profile.
Neura does not write health data. This key is required by the App Store when HealthKit is linked.
Neura uses your location to pre-fill your city and country in your health profile.
Neura uses your camera to scan and save medical documents.
Neura accesses your photo library so you can upload images of your medical documents.
